[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested shoe options include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Neutral Sandals: Flat or heeled sandals in shades like beige, gold, or silver.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. White or Cream Wedges: Wedge sandals in white or cream for a romantic touch.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Factors to consider when choosing shoes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Dress code specified by the wedding invitation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Terrain of the outdoor wedding venue (grass, dirt, pavement).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - User's personal comfort level with heels or flats.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Style and vibe user wants to achieve (casual, elegant, playful).  
[PREFERENCE] User is considering neutral sandals but is unsure whether to choose flat or heeled.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A 2-3 inch heel can be a great option for an outdoor wedding, depending on:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Terrain: Grass or uneven surfaces may require lower heels or flats.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Wedding style: Formal weddings may suit higher heels, while casual ones may not.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. User's comfort level with heels.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Dress length: Heels can balance shorter dresses, while flats may suit longer ones.  
[PREFERENCE] User feels comfortable in heels and believes a 2-3 inch heel will elongate legs and enhance the dress's elegance.
